meta.name: Bigg Boss Malayalam
meta.description: The Malayalam version of the reality show where a number of contestants (known as "housemates") live in a purpose-built house and are isolated from the rest of the world. Each week, housemates nominate two of their fellow housemates for eviction, and the housemates who receive the most nominations faces a public vote out.

videos.title: Mohanlal's Roaring Reality Show
videos.overview: 16 contestants, 100 days of unlimited drama, all in one 'Bigg' house. Catch Mollywood's complete actor, Mohanlal light the fuse to the biggest live reality show in Malayalam.

videos.title: Day 1: Aditi Rai gets maximum nominations for eviction
videos.overview: Less than a day's stay in the Bigg Boss house, Adhithi faces personal comments and ends up shattered in tears. The eventful day simmers down with the first captain being selected.

videos.title: Day 2: Diya and Aditi get into an argument
videos.overview: The housemates face their first ever luxury budget task which requires them to dance as ordered. Will they manage to earn their credit?

videos.title: Day 3: Manoj collapses
videos.overview: The luxury budget task continues as the housemates are divided into two teams, Mohanlal and Mammootty. Manoj collapses after the task and is rushed to the hospital for treatment.

videos.title: Day 4: Manoj Verma makes his exit from Bigg Boss house
videos.overview: Catch the housemates' reactions as tension builds between Sreenish and Archana. Witness an unexpected departure as a contestant is asked to leave the house.

videos.title: Day 5: Underwear Is a Luxury!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss uses the luxury budget as a unique way of addressing Suresh's request for extra underwears. Catch the reaction of the housemates as they get their first luxury supplies.

videos.title: Day 6: Mixed Bag of Emotions
videos.overview: Mohanlal is back and this time he comes bearing gifts and happy news. Ranjini's captaincy is off to a rough start as the housemates turn against her. Catch the Superstar as he builds up the tension for the first round of eliminations.

videos.title: Day 7: May the Famous Be Saved!
videos.overview: Mohanlal takes the eviction to the next level with a unique popularity poll task. Find out who will be voted as the least popular contestant, paving his or her way to an early exit from the house.

videos.title: Day 8: Playing A Double Game
videos.overview: Pearle and Sreelakshmi face severe criticism for their two-faced gameplay. With the next elimination around the corner, will these accusations lead them to being nominated?

videos.title: Day 9: Luxury Task Turns Rough
videos.overview: The luxury budget task, designed to test the business abilities of the housemates, brings out the violent side in some. Amidst all the tension, conspiracies and backstabbing, are new alliances being formed?

videos.title: Day 10: A Saboteur In The Mix!
videos.overview: The luxury task has the housemates questioning their friendships, new and old. Catch what happens when Bigg Boss decides to add a saboteur amidst all the conspiring and the drama.

videos.title: Day 11: Anything to Become the Captain!
videos.overview: The captaincy task has the three contenders trying to outlast one another at the end of a rope. Catch what happens when Srinish is dragged into some embarrassing situations during the captaincy task.

videos.title: Day 12: Sabu's Master Plan
videos.overview: The housemates are given another chance to win back their luxury budget. Catch Sabu do what he does best in a special task. Who will fall victim to his latest prank?

videos.title: Day 13: Ranjini's Captaincy, a Success?
videos.overview: Mohanlal is back with his unique and hilarious take on all of the week's drama. Catch the housemates as they discuss Ranjini's eventful captaincy.

videos.title: Day 14: A New Player in the House
videos.overview: Swetha is in tears as she is faced with a question that will decide the fate of the nominated housemates. Join Mohanlal as he introduces the newest member of the Bigg Boss house.

videos.title: Day 15: Shiyas's Explosive Entry
videos.overview: Being the captain, Srinish is given a special advantage to turn the tables for some in the Bigg Boss house. The housemates are taken aback by Shiya's explosive entry to the house.

videos.title: Day 16: A Killer On the Run
videos.overview: A killer is on the run and murders the contestants one by one as part of this week's luxury budget task. Tune in to find out who will be the killer's first victim.

videos.title: Day 17: A full-blown investigation
videos.overview: Suspicions grow stronger as Swetha and Sabu try to expose the killer by interrogating the housemates. Catch all the action from this episode as Ranjini is asked to murder an investigating officer.

videos.title: Day 18: The Court Is in Session
videos.overview: The housemates finally get a chance to raise their complaints. Catch all the action from this episode as major accusations are thrown at some of the contestants in the court.

videos.title: Day 19: Ranjini, Guilty as Charged!
videos.overview: The court has found Ranjini guilty, and the punishment? Taping her mouth! However, she wins an opportunity to battle it out with Basheer in the captaincy task.

videos.title: Day 20: Shweta Faces the Heat
videos.overview: Mohanlal is back, seeking answers from Shweta for some of the statements made by her after the eviction. Catch all the fun and drama as the World Cup fever hits the Bigg Boss house.

videos.title: Day 21: Sreelakshmi, a Tattletale?
videos.overview: Despite the World Cup fever, all eyes are on the house as the contestants await the audiance's verdict. Catch Sreelakshmi's powerful response to being branded a tattletale.

videos.title: Day 22: Deepan's Birthday Bash!
videos.overview: The house is all set to celebrate Deepan's birthday as the housemates perform a variety of cultural programs. Catch all the fun and action as Pearle and Suresh perform a soulful folk song.

videos.title: Day 23: Ranjini Lashes Out at Pearle
videos.overview: The contestants' brain, brawn and speed are put to test in this week's luxury budget task. Things turn ugly as Ranjini lashes out at Pearle for accusing her of being a useless captain.

videos.title: Day 24: Sabu Apologises to Pearle
videos.overview: Sabu and Pearle sort out their differences before Ranjini calls up a house meeting to address the issues prevailing inside the house. Catch all the action and drama as the housemates perform a skit as a part of the luxury budget task.

videos.title: Day 25: Shiyas, Caught Off Guard
videos.overview: Shiyas faces the heat when the contestants confront him for being an irresponsible leader. Catch the drama as the housemates unite to voice their problems against him in the Bigg Boss court.

videos.title: Day 26: Is Bigg Boss Unfair?
videos.overview: Sabu's antics leads to an ugly situation after a contestant ends up getting slapped. Tune in to find out why the housemates resort to voicing slogans against Bigg Boss and its aftermath.

videos.title: Day 27: A Prayer for Kerala
videos.overview: Mohanlal and the housemates recite a heartfelt prayer for the flood victims and their families in Kerala. Catch the emotional verbal exchange between Anoop and Sreelakshmi that has them both in tears.

videos.title: Day 28: A Shocking Second Eviction
videos.overview: Pearle discusses her plan of action for the coming week as a captain with Mohanlal. Catch all the action and drama as a shocking second eviction devastates the housemates.

videos.title: Day 29: Gossip of the House
videos.overview: Pearle and Srinish become the hot topic of the house as the housemates suspect a budding romance between them. Tune in to witness this week's nomination and its ill-effects on Ranjini and Swetha.

videos.title: Day 30: Welcome to Bigg Boss School
videos.overview: The housemates get a chance to relive their school days in the Bigg Boss school as a part of the weekly task. Anoop's role as a teacher goes too far as Swetha lashes out at him for mistreating her during the task.

videos.title: Day 31: Pearle vs The House?
videos.overview: The luxury budget task continues as the contestants are asked to compete in a speech contest. Catch all the drama as Pearle faces the heat as the housemates turn against her for the statements made by her.

videos.title: Day 32: Music, Dance, Food and Fun
videos.overview: Shiyas and Srinish lock horns in an arm-wrestling match that will decide the last contender for the captaincy. Join Sabu and the housemates as they turn the house into a fun-filled and bustling 'Thattukada'.

videos.title: Day 33: Suresh Against the House!
videos.overview: Suresh gets into trouble for making some derogatory statements about women. Later, Sabu, Diya and Anoop confront the captaincy task. Who will be the next captain?

videos.title: Day 34: Roaring Out with Anger!
videos.overview: Seeing the aggression building among the housemates, Mohanlal gives the irked contestants an opportunity to vent out their anger. Diya's outrageous statement about Archana leaves the housemates in shock.

videos.title: Day 35: The Contestants Face Eviction
videos.overview: The housemates are in for a shock as an unforeseen eviction knocks on their door. Later, certain unexpected turn of events leads to a wild card entry. Who's the new entrant?

videos.title: Day 36: Anjali's Shocking Revelation
videos.overview: Already surprised by the unexpected wild card entry, the housemates are again left startled when Anjali Ameer makes a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Day 37: The Best Nickname Award Goes to!
videos.overview: The housemates gather for an uproaring award night in the house. With Pearle hosting the event, guess the hilarious nicknames awards your favourite contestants will win.

videos.title: Day 38: Story of the House
videos.overview: Adhithi's birthday comes with a big surprise as Bigg Boss grants 2000 luxury points as her birthday gift. Catch all the fun as the contestants are asked to perform a lyrical narrative of a particular incident in the house.

videos.title: Day 39: Friends Turned Foes?
videos.overview: Things turn ugly when Sabu confronts Pearle for ill-treating Anjali. Catch the drama unfold as Pearle holds Sabu accountable for playing a dirty game.

videos.title: Day 40: The Masters and Their Slaves
videos.overview: After a shocking brawl between Basheer and Sabu, the contestants confront an exciting task. The nominated housemates end up becoming the masters and each select a slave from among the contestants.

videos.title: Day 41: A Gift For Shiyas!
videos.overview: In order to boost up Shiyas's energy, Mohanlal has a few interesting plans in mind. But, an unexpected phone call for Pearle brings a startling surprise!

videos.title: Day 42: Who Among the Three?
videos.overview: With Basheer, Diya and Shrinish in the danger zone, the tension builds up in the Bigg Boss house until Mohanlal declares the results for the eliminations. Who among the three faces the door to exit?

videos.title: Day 43: Anjali, Aditi in a Fix
videos.overview: Anjali and Aditi face an ugly situation when Bigg Boss indulges them in a voluntary nomination task. Which among the two, is ready to give up her Bigg Boss dream?

videos.title: Day 44: A Secret Spy!
videos.overview: The housemates are left in shock as they learn about an impostor among themselves. In order to figure out who the traitor is, Sabu comes up with a plan.

videos.title: Day 45: Anjali Quits the Show!
videos.overview: Tears breakout in the house as Anjali's health condition forces her to leave the show. Watch the contestants bid farewell to Anjali as she meets them one last time.

videos.title: Day 46: It's Pearle Vs Shiyas
videos.overview: A heated argument leads to a brawl between Shiyas and Pearle after Shiyas makes an unhealthy remark against her. Suresh tries to make peace but ends up augmenting the situation.

videos.title: Day 47: All Set for a New Captain?
videos.overview: The housemates are left surprised when the contenders for captaincy confront the unexpected. With all the mental and physical preparation done, find out who among Shiyas, Anoop and Aditi is the new captain.

videos.title: Day 48: Ulaganayagan Meets Mohanlal!
videos.overview: The housemates skip a beat as the legendary actor, Kamal Haasan walks into the house. The fun begins when the housemates welcome Kamal Haasan with an uncontrollable excitement and happiness.

videos.title: Day 49: An Unexpected Turn of Events
videos.overview: An unexpected call from Anjali to Mohanlal turns the elimination process upside down. That's not all, considering the public request, an ex-contestant steps into the house. Guess who is it?

videos.title: Day 50: The Captain in Tears!
videos.overview: Shiyas, the captain of the house, finds himself in a fix when the entire house fumes upon him. Watch him stand against all the allegations, but until when?

videos.title: Day 51: Suresh, Pearle in a Tight Spot!
videos.overview: Things take a dirty turn for Suresh and Pearle when the housemates blame Pearle for trapping Suresh in her love. Is it a planned move to create differences between the duo?

videos.title: Day 52: The True Culprits Exposed!
videos.overview: In order to solve the mystery case, Actor Mukesh enters the house as a special investigating officer and surprises the housemates. Watch how Mukesh's investigation unmasks the true culprits before the house.

videos.title: Day 53: Ski Your Way to Captaincy
videos.overview: The Independence Day celebrations continue as the housemates perform a patriotic song written by Suresh. Catch all the fun as Anoop, Archana and Adhithi take part in a unique skiing challenge in the captaincy task.

videos.title: Day 54: Start, Camera, Action!
videos.overview: The Bigg Boss house turns into an acting stage as the housemates audition themselves for a role. The fun begins when Ranjini and Sabu, the Producer and the Director, take up the stage.

videos.title: Day 55: The Housemates in Shock!
videos.overview: Worried for the state going through a natural disaster, the housemates are relieved after they receive calls from their family members. But, the game must go on and the housemates face an exciting task.

videos.title: Day 56: The Judgement Day
videos.overview: Pearle and Suresh stand before the court of Bigg Boss as they are victimized for a few allegations by the housemates. Are these allegations true?

videos.title: Day 57: Shiyas Is Worried
videos.overview: Shiyas feels helpless as he learns that the state is suffering from the devastating floods. Meanwhile, a war of words breaks out in the house between Anoop and Ranjini.

videos.title: Day 58: Compete and Conquer!
videos.overview: The housemates divide into two groups and compete with each other to conquer different parts of the house. Watch to find out which team gains custody over which part of the house.

videos.title: Day 59: An Unpleasant Morning
videos.overview: Ranjini and Basheer's ego clash results in an unpleasant morning for the housemates. Stay tuned as an unexpected declaration from Pearle and Shrinish will leave you in surprise.

videos.title: Day 60: Turmoil in the House
videos.overview: The Bigg Boss house fills with an uproar as Pearle accuses Aditi of using Suresh for her gains. A livid Aditi lashes out at Pearle which splits the house into two groups.

videos.title: Day 61: Hima Threatens Basheer
videos.overview: Hima and Basheer end up in a heated argument as Basheer calls her affection towards Sabu as fake. Hima's reaction irks Basheer, who complains to Bigg Boss.

videos.title: Day 62: Mohanlal Enters the House
videos.overview: Mohanlal enters the Bigg Boss house on the occasion of Onam. The housemates are happy and excited to see the superstar join them for the special moment.

videos.title: Day 63: Love Is In the Air
videos.overview: Pearle and Srinish express their feelings for each other on being asked by Mohanlal about their special bond. A new task is assigned to the housemates dividing them into 2 teams of 5 each.

videos.title: Day 64: The House Sees Tempers Flare
videos.overview: Pearle accuses the new captain, Basheer of being partial which leads to a heated argument between the two. A strung up atmosphere sets in the house as the nominations for elimination begins.

videos.title: Day 65: Shiyas Is Shocked
videos.overview: The housemates ignore Shiyas, who stands clueless as to why everyone is cold towards him. What did he do?

videos.title: Day 66: Shiyas Gets a Makeover!
videos.overview: For the first time in his lifetime, Shiyas dresses as a girl for a task leaving everyone stunned. Meanwhile, the good friends, Sabu and Anoop part ways. But why?

videos.title: Day 67: Let's Tussle
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns the Kabbadi-Kabbadi task to the three contenders of the captaincy post. Archana, Hima and Sreenish tussle with the housemates to win the captaincy.

videos.title: Day 68: Archana's Meltdown
videos.overview: Archana breaks down while working in the kitchen area as a concerned Pearle and Aditi rush in to comfort her. What has happened to the bubbly Archana?

videos.title: Day 69: Basheer Comes Clean
videos.overview: Mohanlal questions Basheer about his verbal spat with Pearle during his tenure as a captain. Tune in to hear Basheer's clarification about the whole incident.

videos.title: Day 70: A Shocking Elimination
videos.overview: Anoop, Shiyas and Pearle are the three nominees that are in the danger of elimination. The housemates are stunned and dazed after the shocking elimination.

videos.title: Day 71: Shiyas Breaks Down
videos.overview: Aditi, Pearle and Srinish rush in to comfort Shiyas as he has an emotional outburst. What made Shiyas feel that way? Tune in to find out.

videos.title: Day 72: Tell Me a Story!
videos.overview: The entire house turns into a laughter club, when the housemates start narrating stories on hilarious subjects provided by Bigg Boss. Don't miss these moments to laugh out loud, tune in, now.

videos.title: Day 73: The Bigg Disappointment
videos.overview: After failing to earn enough luxury points due to the merely impossible tasks, the housemates blame Bigg Boss for being tough on them. Kind-hearted, Bigg Boss decides to show mercy, but will the housemates benefit from it?

videos.title: Day 74: Let's Get Dirty!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a new task to the captaincy contenders Aditi, Shiyas, Suresh and Hima. The contenders are required to test their strength in mud and dirt to become the captain. Who is the strongest of them?

videos.title: Day 75: A Physical Altercation
videos.overview: Hima manhandles Sabu when the latter makes some personal comments about her. Sabu retaliates which leads to a physical altercation between the duo.

videos.title: Day 76: Mohanlal Issues a Warning
videos.overview: Mohanlal is angry on Hima and Sabu for their recent verbal and physical altercation. He sternly warns the duo not to break the house rules.

videos.title: Day 77: An Elimination Worth the Wait
videos.overview: Aditi, Shiyas, Archana and Hima are in the danger zone. The housemates are stunned with the elimination results but nothing in the Bigg Boss happens without a twist. Tune in and find out!

videos.title: Day 78: Aditi in a Tight Spot
videos.overview: Aditi is in for a surprise as she is asked to nominate two people directly for elimination by Bigg Boss. Whom will she nominate?

videos.title: Day 79: All Hail King Shiyas!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a new luxury task to the housemates in which Shiyas is appointed as the king. The housemates are required to abide by the rules made by the king.

videos.title: Day 80: From King to a Prisoner
videos.overview: Shiyas who was appointed as the king in the luxury budget task is overthrown by the new king, Suresh. The new king unleashes his fury on Shiyas and puts him in the makeshift prison.

videos.title: Day 81: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: Divided into two groups, the housemates face the Hide and Seek challenge. But, the game turns hilarious when Sabu's unfair game earns him a punishment from Bigg Boss.

videos.title: Day 82: The Bigg Prank
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a secret task to Shiyas who is unaware that the other housemates are informed of the same. Watch the housemates join Bigg Boss to prank Shiyas

videos.title: Day 83: Put on Your Dancing Shoes
videos.overview: Mohanlal asks a few housemates to dance for the audience after he views them doing the same in the previous episode. Tune in and enjoy the hilarious moments as the housemates shake a leg.

videos.title: Day 84: Aditi Clarifies Her Decision
videos.overview: A heated debate arises in the house as Aditi comes clean about her decision regarding the nomination.

videos.title: Day 85: A Surprise from Mohanlal
videos.overview: The housemates are stunned and excited about receiving a surprise from superstar Mohanlal. Classic Malayalam film, Manichitrathazhu starring the superstar himself is screened for the housemates.

videos.title: Day 86: Pearle-Shrinish Parting Ways?
videos.overview: An unexpected fight between, the only couple, Pearle and Shrinish leaves the Bigg Boss house shocked. The housemates gather to figure out the conflict between the duo.

videos.title: Day 87: Let the Task Begin!
videos.overview: The housemates fasten their belts with the introduction of the luxury budget task. As the game reaches its peak, Sabu gets his eye critically injured.

videos.title: Day 88: The Shiyas - Srinish Show
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a new task to the housemates where Shiyas and Srinish turn talk show hosts. Tune in as the housemates get candid with the duo about their life and career.

videos.title: Day 89: Suresh, Sabu Lock Horns
videos.overview: Suresh and Sabu have an argument over the way Sabu was preparing a dish. Tempers flare between the duo when Suresh says that Sabu spoilt the dish.

videos.title: Day 90: Suresh's Eye Opening Moment
videos.overview: Suresh tells Mohanlal about the moment he changed his mind about quitting the show. What led to the change of heart? Tune in and find out!

videos.title: Day 91: Shiyas Decides to Quit
videos.overview: The housemates are asked to play a game of cricket but with a twist. Tune in to find out why Shiyas is in tears and pleading to leave the house.

videos.title: Day 92: Cooking Up a Storm
videos.overview: Sabu and Pearle try to make something special for the housemates in the kitchen but their attempt turns into a disaster making the duo run for cover. Tune in to witness the hilarious incident!

videos.title: Day 93: Setting the Stage on Fire
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a dance task to the housemates where a stage is set in the house for them. Join the fun as the housemates set the stage on fire with their cool dance moves.

videos.title: Day 94: Freeze, Rewind and Release!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss hides a remote control inside the house which will give the housemates the control to freeze their fellow housemates. Surprised, the housemates engage themselves in finding the remote, but guess who finds it?

videos.title: Day 95: The Ultimate Elimination
videos.overview: It's merely a few days left for the finale and the housemates confront an unexpected elimination. While Aditi and Shiyas await their results, guess who amongst them makes it to the finale?

videos.title: Day 96: Imaginary Bigg Boss Challenge
videos.overview: The housemates are tasked to create an imaginary image of Bigg Boss. Tune in and check out how they unleash their imagination and try to race their contenders.

videos.title: Day 97: A Bigg Surprise
videos.overview: Bigg Boss gives a grand surprise to the housemates leaving them awestruck. Tune in and find out what's in store for the contestants!

videos.title: Day 98: The Grand Finale Is Here
videos.overview: The finale promises flashy lights, rocking performances and loads of entertainment. There is excitement in the air as Mohanlal discloses the name of the winner.

videos.title: BBMal: The Grand Launch
videos.overview: The brand new season of Bigg Boss is here! Superstar Mohanlal welcomes seventeen new housemates, who are eager to begin their journey in the Bigg Boss ouse. Watch the legend get the ball rolling, however, with a twist in the tale.

videos.title: BBMal Day 1: First Captain
videos.overview: As the housemates try to know each other and acquaint themselves with their new abode, Bigg Boss throws open the first challenge. It's time to choose the captain and it won't be easy.

videos.title: BBMal Day 2: The Yearn for their Families
videos.overview: Amidst all the fun, laughter and merry singing sessions, the housemates get their first task, which leaves everyone teary-eyed.

videos.title: BBMal Day 3: Rajith's Tale and the First Argument in House
videos.overview: As the housemates take turns to share their life stories, Rajithkumar's tale leaves everyone shell-shocked.

videos.title: BBMal Day 4: Day 4 in the House
videos.overview: The wave of emotions continues to sweep over the house even today. While Somadas' story touches hearts, Shaji gets into limelight for his style of expression.

videos.title: BBMal Day 5: Arya's Heartbreaking Story
videos.overview: The housemates have gala time as they play a fun game. Later, Arya, the girl who makes everyone laugh shares the heart-breaking story of her life

videos.title: BBMal Day 6: Dharmajan's Unexpected Entry & Exit
videos.overview: To everyone’s surprise, Dharmajan Bolgatty, a comic actor enters the house initially disguised as an emtrant and spends a night with the contestants with fun-filled talks. However, it was short-lived as Mohanlal asks him to come out leaving everyone else confused and sad.

videos.title: BBMal Day 7: The New Captain is Shaji
videos.overview: To elect a new captain, Mohanlal gives a task to Shaji, Rajithkumar and Suresh and Shaji wins. Mohanlal informs everyone that nomination and eviction will begin from the next week.

videos.title: BBMal Day 8: It's Nomination Time and Rajini breaks down.
videos.overview: All were asked to nominate 2 contestants to get evicted for the first time. Rajini cries to Pareekutty’s allegation and the whole inmates console her. Arya, Veena and Pareekkutty talks about Alina’s ‘dirty’ gameplan.

videos.title: BBMal Day 9: Murder task returns
videos.overview: Its role play time in the house! Among other characters, Bigg Boss also lets a killer on the loose with special instructions to execute murders

videos.title: BBMal Day 10: Rajith and Raghu get appointed as the investigative officers
videos.overview: While the murderers are still on a killing spree, two police officers are appointed to investigate the case.

videos.title: BBMal Day 11: Rajani Chandy gets jailed; cries her heart out
videos.overview: Sujo and Alina lock horns. Later, the housemates are asked to pick the top performers of the week while the jail opens up for the worst of the lot.

videos.title: BBMal Day 12: Pradeep Chandran wins the captaincy task
videos.overview: Top performers of the week, Pradeep, Arya and Suresh are in the battle for next captaincy. Meanwhile, a misunderstanding creates a rift between Fukru and Veena.

videos.title: BBMal Day 13: Contestants to face the first nomination task of the season
videos.overview: It's getting hot in here! From Rajith becoming the talking point among the housemates to Mohanlal discussing the upcoming eliminations, it was an eventful day in the house

videos.title: BBMal Day 14: Rajini Chandy gets evicted
videos.overview: Tension mounts in the house as the contestants get set for the first eviction of the season.

videos.title: BBMal Day 15: Somadas Quits the Show
videos.overview: The episode started by Somadas quitting the show due to poor health conditions. After Somadas left, all were asked to nominate 2 contestants for the second eviction. For the first time in the series's history 8 contestants were chosen to face public vote to decide the second evictee.

videos.title: BBMal Day 16: Housemates buckle up for the new weekly task
videos.overview: Reshma and Pradeep's closeness sparks is conversations among the housemates. Amid the hustle of luxury budget task, Rajith's comments trigger an argument.

videos.title: BBMal Day 17: The housemates have taken another challenge
videos.overview: With the luxury budget task already upon them, the housemates have taken another challenge - to resolve Parekutty and Fukru's fight

videos.title: BBMal Day 18: Bigg Boss award ceremony turns into a chaos
videos.overview: Reshma locks horns with Rajith for folding her blanket? As the luxury budget task comes to an end, Bigg Boss surprises the housemates with special awards.

videos.title: BBMal Day 19: Fukru is the new captain
videos.overview: Fukru, Rajith and Veena are fighting it out to be the next captain of the house, in an unfair captaincy task.

videos.title: BBMal Day 20: Mohanlal is coming at the weekend episode
videos.overview: Accidents, arguments, an unexpected eviction, and the daily drama. Mohanlal, certainly has a lot to discuss this week.

videos.title: BBMal Day 21: Housemates to welcome a new contestant
videos.overview: Mohanlal brings a shocker and a surprise as for the housemates. While more than one pack their bags today, new members step into the house as well.

videos.title: BBMal Day 22: Jazla creates a ruckus in the house
videos.overview: Newbie Jazla creates a ruckus in the house and finds it difficult to get along with the housemates.

videos.title: BBMal Day 23: Bigg Boss house turns into a luxury hotel
videos.overview: Welcome to BB hotel! Yes, that's the luxury task of the day where housemates have to please the special guests Rajith and Jazla

videos.title: BBMal Day 24: Rajith calls Sujo ‘Pennalan’; the latter threatens to slap him
videos.overview: Amid the fun and excitement of the luxury budget task, Rajith ends up in a heated argument with Sujo and Jazla

videos.title: BBMal Day 25: Bigg Boss warns Sujo and Rajith
videos.overview: Jazla seems to be getting on everyone's nerves and Veena is the chosen one today. While top three would fight for captaincy, the jail opens up for the worst performers

videos.title: BBMal Day 26: Rajith Kumar is the new captain
videos.overview: It's conflict cooking up in the kitchen for Rajith has some qualms about water. As he along with Arya and Jazla compete for captaincy, he nails the task and wins the title.

videos.title: BBMal Day 27: Thesni Khan gets evicted; admits to not being a competitive contestant
videos.overview: It's that time of the week! Amid a fun task and taking Jazla and Daya to task, Mohanlal announces the result of this week's eviction

videos.title: BBMal Day 28: Sooraj and Pavan enter the house
videos.overview: Mohanlal is meeting the evicted contestant, two handsome hunks make their way into the house.

videos.title: BBMal Day 29: Arya becomes the most 'deserving' contestant
videos.overview: The toughest decision in this game, nominations! While a few of the housemates face the heat, a task to prove how deserving are they leaves the house in splits.

videos.title: BBMal Day 30: Rajith and Reshma lock horns during task
videos.overview: With the luxury budget task at hand, the housemates are on a roll and the house on fire! Amid decisions and arguments, the drama is at an all time high.

videos.title: BBMal Day 31: Bigg Boss house turns into a battlefield
videos.overview: The housemates get all riled up as the luxury budget task continues

videos.title: BBMal Day 32: Pashanam Shaji becomes the new captain
videos.overview: While the housemates happily pick the luxury goods, choosing the contenders for captaincy ain't easy.

videos.title: BBMal Day 33: Housemates are all excited about 'Rasgulla task'
videos.overview: What began like a worked up day turns out to be quite joyful when BB assigns a fun task to the housemates

videos.title: BBMal Day 34: Mohanlal warns Manju for insulting Rajith
videos.overview: Mohanlal connects with the housemates who are under special care for their ill health. Later, the house turns into a courtroom for Manju and Rajith.

videos.title: BBMal Day 35: Mohanlal's surprise turns the housemates emotional
videos.overview: Housemates are emotional thanks to the special messages from their families.To cheer them up, Mohanlal throws in some tasks and a big surprise!

videos.title: BBMal Day 36: Jazla gets exempted from the elimination race
videos.overview: It's that time of the week again! Since the housemates who are unwell can't be nominated, options are fewer. Hence, the decision is tougher.

videos.title: BBMal Day 37: Housemates' prank leaves Daya in tears
videos.overview: Amid pranks and fun, the luxury budget task brings back the chaos. If that was not enough, there's another surprise awaiting the housemates.

videos.title: BBMal Day 38: Rajith accuses housemates of targeting him and Pavan
videos.overview: As the housemates get back from their health check-up, Pavan creates a ruckus as his luxury budget coins go missing. The house is on fire as everyone fights and steals for their points.

videos.title: BBMal Day 39: Fukru and Rajith to end up in a scuffle

videos.title: BBMal Day 40: Pavan Thomas leaves the house due to a medical emergency
videos.overview: Apart from infections and allergies, love is also in the air today. As the housemates indulge in Valentine's special activities, a shock awaits them.

videos.title: BBMal Day 41: Mohanlal questions housemates about the ruckus in the house
videos.overview: With Mohanlal in the house, it's time for some grilling. From discussing the fights to the captaincy task, he has a lot to talk about.

videos.title: BBMal Day 42: Pradeep Chandran gets evicted

videos.overview: Superheroes and supervillains in the house today! The luxury budget task leaves the housemates in splits.

videos.overview: As the task continues and competition gets tough, housemates make new strategies to win.

videos.title: Episode 1 - The Grand Launch
videos.overview: Mohanlal kick-starts the season in style and takes the stage to introduce our high-spirited contestants. Get ready for an evening of unparalleled fun and excitement!

videos.title: Day 1 - First Day, First Fight
videos.overview: Angeline steps into the confession room with her concern. Soon, an eventful first day takes a chaotic turn as some of the housemates get into a heated argument.

videos.title: Day 2 - A Brawl for the Bricks
videos.overview: The nominated contestants put up an intense fight to redeem themselves in the Brick Task. Later, the housemates get emotional when Junaiz and Angeline share their life stories.

videos.title: Day 3 - The First Captaincy Contenders
videos.overview: Maneesha loses her cool when Angeline refuses to adapt to the situation. The housemates take part in a task to secure their chance for next week's captaincy.

videos.title: Day 4 - A Fun Day in the House
videos.overview: After performing an exciting morning activity, the housemates gather to nominate two contestants for jail time. Later, the first Luxury Budget task begins.

videos.title: Day 5 - The First Captain of S5
videos.overview: Rinosh and Anjuz share their life stories. A fierce competition between Akhil and Nadira begins for captaincy. Who will emerge as the winner?

videos.title: Day 6 - Mohanlal's Feedback on First Week
videos.overview: As Mohanlal discusses the first week in the house, the housemates get a chance to tweak their choices for Grenade and Pendant. Sweet surprises are in store for some.

videos.title: Day 7 - A Scrumptious Treat for Lalettan
videos.overview: Mohanlal interacts with the kitchen team to understand their complaints and asks Angeline to prepare Dosa for him. Later, all the housemates engage in a quirky football match.

videos.title: Day 8 - The First Nominations of S5
videos.overview: Housemates get tensed as the first classic nominations for the season begins. Afterwards, Sreedevi breaks down into tears while sharing her personal story.

videos.title: Day 9 - BB Dance Marathon
videos.overview: For the weekly task, the housemates cosplay as famous movie characters in pairs and compete for BB coins. Meanwhile, a verbal fight ensues between Nadira, Reneesha and Cerena.

videos.title: Day 10 - Sobha, Sagar's Tiff
videos.overview: Sobha gets agitated when Maneesha hits the Stop buzzer during her performance. The situation further intensifies when Sagar gets provoked by Sobha's comment.

videos.title: Day 11 - The Results Are Out!
videos.overview: Sobha shares her life story and justifies her stand in yesterday's task. Later, the housemates vote for the best and worst performers of the Dance Marathon. Who will that be?

videos.title: Day 12 - An Emotional Day in the House
videos.overview: Sagar competes against Reneesha and Vishnu and wins the captaincy task. Soon, the housemates turn inconsolable after Lachu shares her heart-rending story.

videos.title: Day 13 - An Apology to the Audience
videos.overview: Mohanlal speaks to the housemates about the ongoing issues and probes into Akhil's comment. He appreciates everyone for the weekly task and gives a surprise to Anjuz.

videos.title: Day 14 - Housemates Go Rogue!
videos.overview: The Easter celebration with Mohanlal turns sour when Akhil and Sagar get into a never-ending ugly fight over the captaincy band. Enraged, Mohanlal makes a shocking decision.

videos.title: Day 15 - An Apology and Wildcard Entry
videos.overview: All the housemates regret their behaviour and sincerely apologise to Mohanlal and BB. Anjuz loses her cool on Devu, while a wildcard entry sweeps everyone off their feet.

videos.title: Day 16 - New Task: Velliyankallu
videos.overview: Reneesha is declared to be the new captain. In the hustle and bustle of the weekly task, merchants try to strike a deal for their diamonds while sea pirates attack Angeline.

videos.title: Day 17 - Rinosh Loses His Temper
videos.overview: The second round begins, and Rinosh becomes furious when the pirates try to snatch his diamonds. As the task ends, who will finally win the Nomination Free card?

videos.title: Day 18 - Vote for the Worst Performer
videos.overview: Akhil and Gopika lock horns, while Hanan's medical condition worsens. Later, BB asks the housemates to select three worst performers of the task. Who will get maximum votes?

videos.title: Day 19 - The Girls Compete For Captaincy
videos.overview: Gopika shares her story, while BB asks the housemates to pick a 'Vishukani' among themselves. Sobha and Nadira battle for the next captaincy. Who will win?

videos.title: Day 20 - Mohanlal Wishes Happy Vishu
videos.overview: Bigg Boss prepares a traditional Vishu Kani for the housemates. The celebrations become even more special when Lalettan enters the house.

videos.title: Day 21 - First Elimination of BBS5
videos.overview: Mohanlal talks about the tasks as well as discusses some of their game strategies with the housemates. Tension mounts for the first eviction of the season. Who will that be?

videos.title: Day 22 - The Chakravyuham Task
videos.overview: Gopika clashes with Sobha when the latter gets involved in the kitchen duties. The Chakravyuham task begins with fiery debate for the safe spot, but ends on a sweet note.

videos.title: Day 23 - What's  Cooking in the Kitchen?
videos.overview: Sagar and the team call out Gopika for not giving due credit for their cooking skills. Elsewhere, BB offers a chance of redemption to the eliminated participants.

videos.title: Day 24 - Mid-week Special with Mohanlal
videos.overview: Lalettan probes into captains Sobha and Gopika's conflict. The housemates enjoy the award ceremony with quirky titles, but a shocking twist leaves them on tenterhooks.

videos.title: Day 25 - Eviction Day
videos.overview: Housemates discuss this week's tasks and the ongoing conflicts with Mohanlal before the mid-week eviction begins. Who will bid farewell to the BB house tonight?

videos.title: Day 26 - Eid Celebrations with BB
videos.overview: Post the nomination process, the housemates get a chance to defend themselves within a time limit. The day ends on a high note with special Eid wishes and a dinner party.

videos.title: Day 27 - Mission Manikyakallu
videos.overview: The task to acquire the golden stone goes downhill as the housemates get into tussles and disagreements. Afterwards, Nadira shares some chapters of her life with everyone.

videos.title: Day 28 - A Team Win!
videos.overview: An investigation begins after Aniyan and his team steal the golden stone. Maneesha receives a reward, and the housemates vote for the best and the worst performers of the week.

videos.title: Day 29 - An Unexpected Exit
videos.overview: Keeping their disagreements and conflicts aside, the housemates come together to secure the luxury goods. Later, an announcement from BB leaves everyone startled.

videos.title: Day 30 - Doll Task and Disputes
videos.overview: It's raining drama in the house with Sruthi breaking down and Maneesha at loggerheads with Sagar. Moreover, a conflict erupts between Junaiz and Sagar over the doll task.

videos.title: Day 31 - Fair or Foul Play?
videos.overview: A strident verbal spat ensues when Vishnu executes his strategy against Devu and Sruthi. After the captaincy contenders are announced, Sagar takes the stage to share his story.

videos.title: Day 32 - A Fight Between Friends
videos.overview: Housemates nominate two contestants for jail time. During the Snake and Ladder task, Shiju-Sruthi and Anjuz-Reneesha get into bitter arguments.

videos.title: Day 33 - Kabaddikalam Task
videos.overview: Reneesha questions the Kabaddikalam judges' decision while Nadira accuses Sruthi of favoritism. How will the housemates resolve the issues and resume the task?

videos.title: Day 34 - Mohanlal Meets the Housemates
videos.overview: Lalettan congratulates Aniyan's team for their win with an exclusive clip. Moreover, he discusses the past week's issues before making an announcement about the wildcard entry.

videos.title: Day 35 - Double Eviction
videos.overview: Mohanlal welcomes Anu and probes into the ongoing issues between the housemates. Later, a shocking double eviction process begins. Whose journey will end today?

videos.title: Day 36 - New Day, New Captain
videos.overview: An engaging pillow fight takes place between the wildcard entrants Anu and Omar. Aniyan takes over as the new house captain after which Sruthi shares her life story.

videos.title: Day 37 - Mission X
videos.overview: For this week's task, housemates divide into teams Alpha and Beta and compete for a fuse. What follows is a series of nasty fights, unfair gameplay and damage to BB property.

videos.title: Day 38 - Alpha vs Beta's Final Fight
videos.overview: The second round begins with Beta defending the doll from Alpha. Amidst this, Sagar's sneak attack leads to an ugly fight. Which team will emerge as the winner?

videos.title: Day 39 - Akhil, Sobha's Fall Out
videos.overview: The worst performers of this week - Akhil, Sobha and Omar compete in a task to avoid BB jail. Things turn sour real quick when Sobha gives Akhil a stern warning for his comment.

videos.title: Day 40 - And the New Captain Is ...
videos.overview: Kitchen captain Reneesha engages in a fight with Akhil after he gives her a suggestion. On the other hand, Anu, Vishnu and Shiju fight for the next week's captaincy. Who will win?

videos.title: Day 41 - A Weekly Recap
videos.overview: Mohanlal reviews this week's hot issues and puts an end to the housemates' discords. In addition, he hosts a fun game before saving a housemate from eviction.

videos.title: Day 42 - Elimination Day
videos.overview: As the housemates engage themselves in the weekend fun with Mohanlal, tension mounts for the nominated ones. Who will join him onstage today?

videos.title: Day 43 - A Day of Fun and Frolic
videos.overview: The nomination process raises the heat for the members of Team Alpha. Later, the mood changes as the housemates enthusiastically participate in a fun Kalam Maatam task.

videos.title: Day 44 - An Endurance Test
videos.overview: Sobha and Akhil lock horns once again regarding the wheat dough. With their immunity at stake, each housemate's physical strength is put to the test in the new weekly task.

videos.title: Day 45 - The Battle Gets Fierce
videos.overview: The challenging task makes the players break a sweat and eventually, they engage in a heated argument. Vishnu's strategy against his competitors adds fuel to the fire.

videos.title: Day 46 - A Brawl for the Buns
videos.overview: Soon after the worst performers of the week are chosen, Anu confronts Sruthi - Vishnu for secretly eating the buns. The argument intensifies when other housemates get involved.

videos.title: Day 47 - What's Brewing in the House?
videos.overview: A serious discussion unfolds after Junaiz confesses his feelings to Cerena. Later, the best performers compete in an arduous task for captaincy.

videos.title: Day 48 - A Dedication to the Mothers!
videos.overview: The atmosphere gets heated up when Lalettan starts discussing the weekly task. Later, the housemates read out the letters to their mom and get a special surprise from Mohanlal.

videos.title: Day 49 - Half Way Through the Journey
videos.overview: Mohanlal celebrates the successful completion of 50 days with the housemates and shows them a quick recap of their amazing journey. Who will bid goodbye to the house today?

videos.title: Day 50 - Welcome to BB Hotel!
videos.overview: After the nominations, manager Junaiz and the BB hotel staff gear up to host their guests - Robin and Rajith. However, pandemonium ensues as Vishnu starts arguing with Rajith.

videos.title: Day 51 - BB Hotel Manager vs Staff
videos.overview: Sagar tries to snatch BB money from guest Rajith, while Akhil resigns from his duty. Situations intensify for Junaiz when Bigg Boss asks him to update the staff roster.

videos.title: Day 52 - It's Party Time in BB Hotel!
videos.overview: As Rinosh becomes the new manager, the housemates start reviewing Junaiz's performance, and chaos ensues. Later, everyone gears up for BB Hotel's anniversary celebrations.

videos.title: Day 53 - Task Results Create Turmoil
videos.overview: A tiff between Cerena and Reneesha regarding the BB money leads to a huge argument. Junaiz, Akhil and Robin lose their cool and are called to the confession room. What next?

videos.title: Day 54 - Catch it if You Can
videos.overview: With a heavy heart, the housemates bid goodbye to their lovely guest, Rajith. While the worst performers are locked in jail, Junaiz, Sagar, and Shiju compete for captaincy.

videos.title: Day 55 - Punishment and Eviction
videos.overview: Mohanlal questions the housemates about the BB Hotel task mishaps. Vishu pays an extra penalty for sleeping during the day, while the eviction results are declared via a game.

videos.title: Day 56 - Happy Birthday Laletta!
videos.overview: With glitz, glamour and grand surprises, Bigg Boss family lavishly celebrates Mohanlal's birthday. Special wishes, performances and lots more is in store for our beloved star.

videos.title: Day 57 - Nominations with a Twist
videos.overview: The housemates split into teams and each team is asked to nominate one amongst themselves. Consequently, the discussion leads to heated altercations and a sobfest.

videos.title: Day 58 - It's a Test of Patience
videos.overview: As a part of the 'No-fight' task, the housemates take a vow to maintain peace throughout the week. Can they endure and complete today's challenges without any setbacks?

videos.title: BBMal Day 1: The Hero's Chosen Squad
videos.overview: The season's first captain picks the Power Team. Fiery fights erupt in the house while an unexpected twist in the nomination ignites shock. What's next in BB's bag of surprises?

videos.title: Day 2: Fortune-Telling and fights
videos.overview: Following an exhilarating prophecy session with 'Kumbidi' Suresh, Ratheesh and Jaanmoni argue. The Power Team discover their abilities, after which Ormagal task begins.

videos.title: Day 3: Task to Takeover the power Room
videos.overview: After an altercation with Suresh, Ratheesh decides to walk out of the show. In BB's new challenge, Den, Nest and Tunnel room teams get to fight for the Power room.

videos.title: Day 4: Is it Truth or Fake News
videos.overview: Suresh and Norah share their stories, while orders from the Power Team creates ruckus in the house. The teams later engage in an intellectual task to secure more points.

videos.title: BBMal Day 5: First Jail Nominations
videos.overview: Amidst Jinto and Sijo's dispute, a prank by Suresh leads to CID Ramdas' unexpected visit. The Power Room results are announced, and the first jail nomination commences with chaos.

videos.title: BBMal Day 6: Know Your Housemates
videos.overview: Mohanlal scrutinises the housemates about the past week's turmoil. Following a critical self-assessment task, the housemates get a special report from CID Ramdas.

videos.title: BBMal Day 7: First Elimination
videos.overview: Mohanlal investigates Jinto's complaint and evaluates Arjun's leadership. Sijo, Apsara, and Reshmin compete for the next captaincy, while tension mounts for the eviction.

videos.title: BBMal Day 8: Switching Seats
videos.overview: The Power Team ranks themselves and swaps out the fifth member for this week. Later, Rishi unleashes his fury on Gabri and Jasmine over nominations.

videos.title: BBMal Day 9: A Frosty Showdown
videos.overview: Three 'kids' from the Power Team storm the house with mischief. Gabri locks horns with Jaanmoni over ice cream, while Resmin breaks a rule in the chaos.

videos.title: BBMal Day 10: Team Tensions and Tiffs
videos.overview: The day turns eventful with Rishi's life story, and a conflict in the power team. During a task, Gabri and Jasmine accuse Rocky of aggression, then provoke him, igniting a dispute

videos.title: BBMal Day 11: BB's Stern Warning
videos.overview: BB issues a warning to Rocky for his antics, while Sijo, Jasmine, and Gabri get into a verbal spat. The atmosphere eases later as teams mimic the Power Team's actions for a task.

videos.title: BBMal Day 12: New Power Team?
videos.overview: The Tunnel Team competes in a strength challenge against the current Power Team to take over their advantage. Later, Arjun gains attention for both positive and negative reasons.

videos.title: BBMal Day 13: A Saturday Surprise!
videos.overview: Lalettan kick-starts the evening with Power Team's evaluation and discusses Rocky, Gabri, and Jasmine's drama. He further dishes out Rocky's fate and shocks with an eviction twist.

videos.title: BBMal Day 14: Trust Quest
videos.overview: Applause fills the house for Jinto and Apsara's performance and her captaincy. Following a gripping captaincy task, Mohanlal sets the stage for a trust trial and an eviction.

videos.title: BBMal Day 15: Rocky's Recklessness
videos.overview: Pandemonium ensues in the house when Kitchen captain Rocky unleashes his fury on Sijo, leading to a summons from BB. What uncertain destiny awaits Rocky?

videos.title: BBMal Day 16: BB Circus
videos.overview: Housemates gear up for an exciting BB Circus task, where the teams face each other in three rounds. In a turn of events, Ansiba steps in for Sijo as this week's Captain.

videos.title: BBMal Day 17: It's a Tie!
videos.overview: All three teams score the same, giving the Power team an advantage to choose their opponent. Sreerekha talks about herself, while BB asks everyone to share their love life.

videos.title: BBMal Day 18: Team Discord
videos.overview: Complaints against Jinto prompts Resmin to punish him, which sparks an argument. The Nest Team gears up for the final challenge. Can they overthrow the Power Team?

videos.title: BBMal Day 19: Welcome, New Captain
videos.overview: Duty loses priority as Jaanmoni fights Gabri, while Norah and the kitchen team's misunderstanding escalates. Following an exciting captaincy task, housemates pick the next inmates

videos.title: BBMal Day 20: Where Is Sijo?
videos.overview: Mohanlal explores the aftermath of past week's incidents, questioning the housemates' silence on Sijo. Later, he addresses rule breaches and makes a very important announcement.

videos.title: BBMal Day 21: Happy Easter!
videos.overview: Lalettan sparks Easter joy among the housemates and celebrates it with alluring performances. Later, they dive into a spirited campaign as he opens a new spot in the Power team.

videos.title: BBMal Day 22: First Open Nominations
videos.overview: Captain Jaanmoni takes charge, while Jinto apologises for his nap mishap. Yamuna's rebellion against cooking norms shakes the house, followed by a shocking open nominations.

videos.title: BBMal Day 23: Alakku Company Task
videos.overview: A series of argument erupts following upsetting remarks by some housemates. Jinto is called into the confession room, after which he locks horns with Gabri over the laundry task.

videos.title: BBMal Day 24: Battery Low
videos.overview: BB intervenes when the penalty discussion between Jasmine, Jinto, and Gabri intensifies. Furthermore, Saranya points fingers at Gabri and Rishi over the Charging task.

videos.title: BBMal Day 25: Target, Ignore, Protect Task
videos.overview: It's the final round to grab points and become the winning team, as captaincy is at stake. During the next task, arguments arise between Jasmine, Norah and Resmin.

videos.title: BBMal Day 26: Tiffs Within the Tunnel Team
videos.overview: Yamuna and the other Tunnel team members exchange heated words while choosing the next captain. Gabri braces himself for a dual punishment: one from PT and another in jail.

videos.title: BBMal Day 27: Spot Eviction?
videos.overview: Mohanlal delves into the kitchen oversight, while Gabri and Jinto's language slip-ups threaten their stay. What would be the punishments and who'll bid goodbye?

videos.title: BBMal Day 28: Make Way for the Wildcards!
videos.overview: As Lalettan reviews Power Team's performance, ex- captain Jaanmoni faces grievances. Unbeknownst to them, he orchestrates the wildcard reveal, sparking intense anticipation.

videos.title: BBMal Day 29: New Members in the BB House
videos.overview: As the newcomers are welcomed with enthusiasm, Jasmine steps up as the captain. The joy fades as disputes arise among the wildcards, and an open nomination add fuel to the fire.

videos.title: BBMal Day 30: Power Team Turns Journalists
videos.overview: Jaanmoni creates ruckus during the meeting, while Ansiba and Apsara clash. In today's task, the Power team gets to question the others, leading to heated discussions.

videos.title: BBMal Day 31: Outbursts Overloaded
videos.overview: Ansiba gets punished for missing the PT session. Emotions run high when BB assigns a morning activity and a quiz game about how well you know the house and housemates.

videos.title: BBMal Day 32: Eid Celebrations in the House
videos.overview: After some arguments and entertaining acts, the Tunnel team takes on the Power team in the final tug-of-war battle. Later, everyone gathers around to enjoy the Eid festivities.

videos.title: BBMal Day 33: BB Ballot
videos.overview: BB's warning rings alarms for Jaanmoni after her spat with Norah, while Abhishek K shares his story. Sreerekha's choice during the captaincy election fractures Nest team's unity.

videos.title: BBMal Day 34: First Yellow Card of the Season
videos.overview: It's a day of punishments and warnings for the housemates as Mohanlal reviews the past week's happenings. Meanwhile, who will be saved from eviction today?

videos.title: BBMal Day 35: Vishu Ashamsakal
videos.overview: Welcoming the Malayalam New Year with zeal, Mohanlal joins the housemates in celebration. He then reveals the new captain, counsels Jinto, and plays a clip for Gabri- Jasmine.

videos.title: BBMal Day 36: Emotional Endurance Put to Test
videos.overview: Jasmine and Gabri's emotional instability becomes the talk of the house. Captain Jinto assigns tasks to the housemates, while PT reviews candidates to replace Abhishek S.

videos.title: BBMal Day 37: Melodramas of BBS6
videos.overview: Chaos ensues when the Power team locks the Den, and demands an apology from Gabri. However, the mood lightens when each team performs hilarious skits imitating the others.

videos.title: BBMal Day 38: Bigg Brawls
videos.overview: Jasmine, Sibin and Gabri's feud ignites intense arguments in the house. Norah's rule slip earns her a penalty, while teams gear up for a tricky balance test.

videos.title: BBMal Day 39: It's Team Nest vs the Power Team
videos.overview: Once again, hygiene becomes a topic of discussion in the house, leading to a verbal war. Team Nest is chosen as the Power team's opponent for the final challenge. Who will win it?

videos.title: BBMal Day 40: Jail Nomination and Captaincy
videos.overview: Sibin's misconduct stirs trouble, while Norah and Jasmine top the list of jail nominations. Sreethu, Jinto, and Nandana battle it out for the next Captaincy.

videos.title: BBMal Day 41: Mohanlal Demands an Answer
videos.overview: Mohanlal reprimands the housemates for their misuse of power, unfair outcomes, and inappropriate behavior. Norah receives a special gift before this week's eviction.

videos.title: BBMal Day 42: Appreciations and Advices
videos.overview: Sreerekha and Sibin earn praise for their impactful performance from Mohanlal, while Jinto's leadership draws criticism. Inmates face questions about rule violations and hygiene.

videos.title: BBMal Day 43: Captain Sreethu on Duty
videos.overview: Pooja's health crisis and Sibin's withdrawn demeanour stir panic, while Captain Sreethu takes charge. Two spots are up for grabs in the PT, and the nominations increase tension.

videos.title: BBMal Day 44: The Power Tower
videos.overview: As the morning unfolds with a hilarious Nunaa task, BB summons Sibin to the confession room. Despite teams facing a strenuous challenge, 'Nimisha Kavi' task lightens the mood.

videos.title: BBMal Day 45: Welcome Back Sijo!
videos.overview: Sijo's surprise arrival delights everyone. Conversely, Gabri and Jasmine's relationship encounters turbulence. Later, the housemates lift spirits with an energetic rap performance.

videos.title: BBMal Day 46: The Danger Coin Task
videos.overview: An overwhelmed Resmin breaks down in front of BB, while Jabri still try to resolve their conflict. The final battle for PT intensifies as Jinto and Gabri engage in a physical war.

videos.title: BBMal Day 47: A Press Meet with Pavi Caretaker

videos.title: BBMal Day 73: Dolls, Drama and a Divided House

videos.title: BBMal Day 74: A Day of Shocking Revelations
videos.overview: The Scratch and Win task begins, and Aryan is caught hiding coins, sparking tension. Later, Adhila's emotional confession to Akbar about the stolen dolls stuns the entire house.

videos.title: BBMal Day 75: A Secret Task Ends in Bitter Betrayal
videos.overview: The house holds jail nominations. Afterwards, Bigg Boss picks Shanavas for a secret task that creates chaos, ending in a dramatic reveal and a broken friendship with Aneesh.

videos.title: BBMal Day 76: No Hiding from Lalettan's Lens
videos.overview: Mohanlal reviews the week's nomination and captaincy task drama. Lakshmi plays advocate in a mock trial, while a fun task forces housemates to label each other with word cards.

videos.title: BBMal Day 77: Gearing Up for the Final Gauntlet
videos.overview: Aneesh gets the 'honour' of being the most jailed housemate. Lalettan puts Anumol in a spot, highlighting her disregard for food rations. The star launches the Ticket to Finale.

videos.title: BBMal Day 78: A Diwali of Twists and Tasks
videos.overview: The Ticket to Finale begins with an endurance task. The house celebrates Diwali with a surprise guest, but tensions rise with a new captaincy rule.

videos.title: BBMal Day 79: Finale Race and Prank Wars!
videos.overview: The housemates face two tough Ticket to Finale tasks. Later, after imagining themselves as winners in a press interview, Aryan, Noora, Adhila and Anumol plan a prank on the house.

videos.title: BBMal Day 80: Food, Water and Fight, Fight, Fight!
videos.overview: Food becomes a topic of contention this time. Drama erupts between Nevin and Anumol when they start splashing water on each other. A heated Ticket to Finale task ensues.

videos.title: BBMal Day 81: Kitchen Fight Turns Serious
videos.overview: A vessel-washing argument turns into a physical fight, injuring Shanavas and causing Bigg Boss to intervene. Two Ticket to Finale tasks get played.

videos.title: BBMal Day 82: Road to Finale
videos.overview: Pressure mounts within the house towards the finale as disputes increase about duties, responsibilities and food rations. The Ticket to Finale tasks end.

videos.title: BBMal Day 83: A Winner and a Warning
videos.overview: Nevin is in the hot seat as Mohanlal confronts him about his past actions. Noora is then celebrated as the Ticket to Finale winner.

videos.title: BBMal Day 84: To Take the Money Box or Not
videos.overview: Shanavas returns to the house. Lalettan asks about the trio's captaincy. The money box comes into play again, and the housemates have a choice to make.

videos.title: BBMal Day 85: Bigg Bank Week Kicks Off!
videos.overview: A shocking twist puts everyone except Noora on the nomination list! The Bigg Bank Week kicks off with cash-grab tasks, but Nevin is banned from competing for money.

videos.title: BBMal Day 86: A Friend Lost, An Ally Found?
videos.overview: Anumol clashes with her friend Adhila over food, and Captain Noora moves her to a new team. This leads to another argument, but Aneesh supports Anumol during a house meeting.

videos.title: BBMal Day 87: Fights, Friction and a Fortune!
videos.overview: Aneesh attempts to mend Anumol and Adhila's friendship. The Laksha Yudham task ends with a twist. Later, Anumol refuses to wash dishes, leading to another complaint.

videos.title: BBMal Day 88: From Big Bank to Big Pops
videos.overview: The house faces a high-stakes task with eviction on the line. Sabuman clashes with Nevin over disrespect. The mood lightens with a hilarious "Thottal Potti" balloon challenge.

videos.title: BBMal Day 89: A Proposal Amid Peace
videos.overview: Aneesh asks a very important question to Anumol. While she waves the white flag with the others, BB announces who the best performer in the house is.

videos.title: BBMal Day 90: Love's in the Air on Kerala Day
videos.overview: Mohanlal celebrates Kerala Day with a quiz. He then discusses Aneesh's proposal, the kitchen fights, and Nevin's missed money task. The night ends with the nomination reveal.

videos.title: BBMal Day 91: Staying Friends and Fond Farewells
videos.overview: Nevin finally gets a chance to earn money tonight. Lalettan asks the housemates to name one potential post-BB friend and the Star of the Show. But it's also time for an eviction.

videos.title: BBMal Day 92: When the Past Walks Back In
videos.overview: Anumol clears the air with Aneesh, only to clash with Adhila. The final BB nomination begins, but the big shock is the return of ex-housemates, one of whom confronts Anumol.

videos.title: BBMal Day 93: A Not-So-Happy Reunion
videos.overview: An all-out war erupts as ex-housemates return. Sarath and Bincy confront Anumol, Nevin clashes with Jishin, and Noora argues with Sarika over past statements.

videos.title: BBMal Day 94: The Final Seven
videos.overview: It's a day of re-entries as more evictees return. Although Anumol's game and PR strategy worry a few, Shanavas attempts to mediate the conflict between her, Adhila and Noora.

videos.title: BBMal Day 95: One Final Look Back, One Final Cut
videos.overview: The day is full of emotion as housemates give apologies and watch videos of fights and friendships. But the night ends in heartbreak with a final, brutal mid-week eviction.

videos.title: BBMal Day 96: A Night of Music and Goodbyes
videos.overview: Anumol tries to clear her name with Akbar, but he refuses to talk. The mood lifts with Shivangi's concert, followed by a special dinner before all evictees exit.

videos.title: BBMal Day 97: Memories, Makeovers and the Final 5
videos.overview: The housemates get emotional in the Ormakal and Mirror tasks. However, another brutal eviction reveals the Final 5, who are rewarded with a special makeover.

videos.title: BBMal Day 98: Grand Finale
videos.overview: After 14 tumultuous weeks of drama, rivalry and fierce competition, it's a moment of truth when Mohanlal ushers the finalists to the stage. Who will win Season 7's trophy?

videos.title: BBMal Day 5: Jail Drama and a Luxury Budget Twist
videos.overview: Jail nomination turns heated as Eldho calls the ruling party a failure. Rini gets emotional with Rahul over her past case, and the housemates earn luxury budget access.

videos.title: BBMal Day 8: Re-Election and Red Paint Revenge

videos.title: BBMal Day 10: Can New Contractors Save BB City?

videos.title: BBMal Day 12: Jail Food Before Actual Jail Time
videos.overview: The housemates quarrel over always being served porridge for meals. Soon after, the captaincy race takes an unexpected twist, and a gruelling jail task decides who gets locked in.

videos.title: BBMal Day 13: Lalettan Confronts Rahul and Azif
videos.overview: Mohanlal opens a debate on democracy, exposes Rahul’s domineering leadership, crowns Noby Player of the Week, and sternly warns Azif over his foul language.

videos.title: BBMal Day 14: Secrets Out and an Eviction In
videos.overview: Mohanlal addresses nomination, a secret milk drinking video stuns the house, and a hygiene debate leads to an eviction. Plus, a special surprise awaits Mohanlal from Bigg Boss.

videos.title: BBMal Day 15: Nomination Task and Explosive Fights
videos.overview: Aishwarya slams Komban after fighting with Neha. Meanwhile, everyone questions the leader’s nomination picks and the Commoner task leads to heated fights.

videos.title: BBMal Day 16: Mass Break-In and Massive Food Raid
videos.overview: House access gets restricted, but Eldho steals the timer, prompting the leader to block entry. But locked-out housemates break in, causing property damage.

videos.title: BBMal Day 17: Bans, Brawls and Blockades
videos.overview: Sreelakshmi steals eggs, which sparks a food ban. While the leader picks two housemates to enter the house, the Movie Poster Task is cancelled after fights get too physical.

videos.overview: Aggression between Tashi and Gautham causes alarm. Bigg Boss summons them separately, cancels the weekly task, and promises strict action over the weekend.

videos.overview: Jail nomination sees Shibina, Tashi and Shijin with the highest votes. The nominees face a court task where they must choose an advocate to fight their case.

videos.title: BBMal Day 20: Lalettan Issues an Ultimatum
videos.overview: The house and Noby come under fire when Mohanlal brings up the week's unruly behaviour. The tension escalates when the star directly nominates housemates for next week.

videos.title: BBMal Day 21: Lalettan Demands Answers
videos.overview: Mohanlal tackles courtroom drama, clears house conflicts, and awards Sreelakshmi a golden apron with special perks. Sumesh's team performs a play before one contestant packs bags.

videos.title: BBMal Day 22: Inventory Task Goes Topsy-Turvy
videos.overview: Rahul and Shijin go head-to-head in the leadership candidate selection. When the final 4 are selected, a task with house inventory gives everyone a chance. However, chaos erupts.

videos.overview: A ballot vote elects the new leader, but Tashi refuses to take part. The house embraces horror as the Vampires vs Villagers task begins.

videos.title: BBMal Day 24: Secret Tasks and Prank Drama
videos.overview: The secret tasks push the house to chaos. Loletta and Azif swap sides, and the Villagers pull off a staged fight to win a secret mission.

videos.title: BBMal Day 25: Twisted Mind Games and Team Swaps
videos.overview: Azif and Jaseela clash over stolen rice. Mind games fail as no one switches sides, but a task win lets Vampires pick a Villager before the intense cultural round final showdown.

videos.title: BBMal Day 26: Leadership Reality Check for Shijin
videos.overview: The housemates share the pros and cons of Shijin's leadership during the morning activity. At the jail nomination, Shijin unleashes his special leader power. Who is it for?

videos.title: BBMal Day 27: Mass Eviction Hits the House
videos.overview: A mass eviction announcement shocks clueless housemates. A Freeze Release task begins with a fight before multiple evictions roll out, leading to a Secret Room twist.

videos.title: BBMal Day 28: Four New Wildcards Shake the House
videos.overview: The spit controversy explodes after Shijin questions Aishwarya over spitting on Komban. Later, four surprise wildcard entrants step inside to shake up the entire house.

videos.title: BBMal Day 29: Wildcards Seize Captaincy
videos.overview: Big Boss appoints the four wildcards as house captains to lead duties. With direct nomination power in their hands, the new leaders turn the eviction process upside down.

videos.title: BBMal Day 30: Secret Tasks, Tears and Exit Plea
videos.overview: Shijin argues over missing food, while Nilina and Noby get upset over a comment. Wildcards get a secret task, and Suvarna breaks down in the confession room, asking to quit.

videos.title: BBMal Day 31: Candy Clash Saga
videos.overview: The Mittayi Pattanam task takes over the house, and everyone gets consumed by candies. Meanwhile, Suvarna finally makes a tough decision.

videos.title: BBMal Day 32: Bigg Trouble in Candy House
videos.overview: The housemates land in hot water due to complaints, cheating, rule-breaking and causing disorder. In between fights and rising tension, Bigg Boss welcomes two guests.

videos.title: BBMal Day 33: Leadership Ratings and Janasabha
videos.overview: The housemates rate wildcards for their leadership, which turns ugly. Later, Aishwarya breaks down in the confession room as this week's Janasabha begins.

videos.title: BBMal Day 34: Lalettan's Revelations and Warnings
videos.overview: Mohanlal tackles groupism, exposes Rahul as a puppeteer, and takes away Noby's trophy. Later, video evidence puts Noby on notice, while Tashi lands in deep trouble for aggression.

videos.title: BBMal Day 35: Chinese Whispers and Harsh Truths
videos.overview: Lalettan confronts housemates over rule-breaking and food spats. Later, the Chinese Whisper task creates chaos, and Tashi gets called out for twisting the story.

videos.title: BBMal Day 36: New Wildcard and Twisted Nomination
videos.overview: Komban and Vedangi battle for leadership. Meanwhile, a new wildcard watches housemates face a timed nomination twist, triggering a massive clash between Rahul and Anjali.

videos.title: BBMal Day 37: A Deadly Twist in the Underworld
videos.overview: A feast begins as gangster guests arrive. BB assigns special missions and warns of undercover killers, while Mridula receives a deadly task against Vedangi.

videos.title: BBMal Day 38: The Murder Mystery Deepens
videos.overview: The housemates discuss Vedangi's morning task. Mridula goes on a killing spree. Soon after, Anjali steps in to resolve the case.

videos.title: BBMal Day 39: The Mastermind Slips Away
videos.overview: Shijin confronts Komban over sleeping on duty. Wikky and Tashi clash during the killer hunt as Wikky is caught and the mastermind escapes.

videos.title: BBMal Day 40: Jail Looms, Fights Erupt
videos.overview: Azif becomes the best performer in the weekly task. Arguments erupt and special powers get used during the jail nomination. Who will end up inside?

videos.title: BBMal Day 41: Weekend Heat with Lalettan
videos.overview: Lalettan welcomes the wildcard and reviews Tashi and Wikky's fight. He questions Nowfina, Vedangi and Neelina over nominations, brings a surprise for Gautham, and conducts a quiz.

videos.title: BBMal Day 42: Walkout Threats and Eviction Shock
videos.overview: Lalettan warns Wikky over walkout threats and grills Komban's captaincy. An emotional audio from home brings tears before a tense eviction leaves the house in shock.

videos.title: BBMal Day 43: Fighting with Foam
videos.overview: Open nominations begin, triggering clashes. It's a day of heated verbal fights with a heavy dose of foam.

videos.overview: A new task begins: Kappal Yathra, which can win an eviction-free card. There is also gold to mine and pirates to be wary of. But, in the middle of this, what is wrong with Gautham?

videos.title: BBMal Day 45: Gold, Greed and a New Captain
videos.overview: Neha becomes captain as boat drama escalates, while Shijin ignites PR and groupism claims. Gold mining triggers fierce clashes before one housemate secures the highest gold count.

videos.overview: Rule breaks cost the housemates their budget, and all hell breaks loose. Noby and Komban nearly throw hands, pulling Azif and Gautham straight into the storm.

videos.title: BBMal Day 47: Leader Issues and Best Player Blues
videos.overview: Komban and Aishwarya argue over his undisclosed relationship. As the leader, Mridula chooses the Best Player of the Week, but Neha feels hurt. The Eviction Free Pass task begins!

videos.title: BBMal Day 48: Weekend Review and Big Surprises
videos.overview: Lalettan revisits Noby and Komban's fight, checking on women's safety. Surprise calls await the duo before the spotlight turns strictly on rule breakers for this week's budget cut.

videos.title: BBMal Day 49: Milestone Celebrations with a Twist
videos.overview: As Mohanlal resolves heated conflicts, the house celebrates the 50th episode with dance-offs. A new captain is chosen, followed by an unexpected eviction surprise.

videos.title: BBMal Day 50: Ticket to Week 12 Dilemma
videos.overview: Aishwarya takes charge as captain, leading to arguments with Tashi and Shijin. The housemates bid for a ticket-to-finale pass, but a difficult choice awaits them.

videos.title: BBMal Day 51: Bossy Tag, Tears and Lost Money
videos.overview: Aishwarya faces backlash from Komban and Tashi over her leadership. Later, the remaining prize money is revealed, and an intense weekly team task begins with Rahul as judge.

videos.title: BBMal Day 52: Sacrifices, Heartbreak and Task War
videos.overview: Anjali loses the captaincy race after being eliminated, and Shijin questions the decision. Neha and Tashi end their bond. Team Yellow and Team Purple battle for the win.

videos.title: BBMal Day 53: A Lost Dream and Boxing Ring Chaos
videos.overview: One housemate loses their shot at captaincy forever. A heated five-round ring war puts the referee on the spot, with Shijin clashing over the final call.

videos.title: BBMal Day 54: The Race for Leadership Begins
videos.overview: Jail nominations land two housemates behind bars. Nowfina clears the air with Neha, while Wikky and Gautham battle for captaincy with team support.

videos.title: BBMal Day 55: Lalettan Corners Rahul with a Deal
videos.overview: Lalettan tests Rahul with a ₹25 lakh walkout deal and reviews his refereeing. Shijin is cleared of accusations, while three contestants are declared safe.

videos.title: BBMal Day 56: Tears and Truths with Lalettan
videos.overview: Lalettan kicks off the night with Kerala Piravi greetings and reviews Mridula's accusations. Neha gets an emotional parent visit, and the night concludes with a shocking eviction.

videos.title: BBMal Day 57: Burning Photos and Bitter Tears
videos.overview: While Wikky takes charge as leader, Neha breaks down over Komban's remarks. The housemates burn photos in fiery open nominations, triggering a fight between Vipin and Gautham.

videos.title: BBMal Day 58: Grabbing Missiles for Money

videos.title: BBMal Day 59: Petty Wars and a Missing Bomb
videos.overview: As heated arguments break out over chores and teasing, Noby faces an early exit in the task. Meanwhile, Gautham secretly steals the real atom bomb but denies all charges.

videos.title: BBMal Day 60: All Bombs Go Missing
videos.overview: Gautham and Shijin fight over stolen bombs. Meanwhile, Mridula and Nowfina pull off a sneaky heist. Later, emotional video messages from parents leave the housemates in tears.

videos.title: BBMal Day 61: A Bitter Battle for Leadership
videos.overview: Operation Last Missile ends in intense struggles and two eliminations as a new leader is crowned. Meanwhile, Shijin relentlessly grills Mridula over her task strategy.

videos.title: BBMal Day 62: Thalachor, Thefts and a Big Cheque
videos.overview: Lalettan tackles bias claims over Neha and reviews task theft drama. After grilling housemates over the missing atom bomb and fake heists, the true mastermind bags his prize money.

videos.title: BBMal Day 63: Diwali Delights with Lalettan
videos.overview: After Mohanlal's weekly round-up, Diwali in the BB House begins with a bang when the superstar enters the house. Food, gifts and entertainment abound, but an eviction awaits.

videos.title: BBMal Day 64: Teddy Drama and Muddy Waters
videos.overview: A new guest brings ration-cut threats. The housemates pour muddy water on each other during nominations, igniting fierce drama between Anjali, Aishwarya, Komban and Mridula.

videos.overview: The Teddy Task ends with rule violations and ration cuts. Trouble escalates when Season 4 legends enter to challenge the housemates for a shot at redeeming the lost prize money.

videos.title: BBMal Day 66: Season 5 Legends Shake Up the House
videos.overview: Tensions rise between Shijin, Azif and Tashi over the Teddy task and kitchen duties. Later, Season 5 legends take over to put the house in the hot seat.

videos.title: BBMal Day 67: Legends Expose Flaws
videos.overview: The housemates face the Season 5 legends in a ₹2 lakh coin challenge. Fresh clashes erupt, and Season 6 legends enter to host the mirror evaluation task.

videos.title: BBMal Day 68: Legendary Challenges and Judgements
videos.overview: Season 6 legends challenge the housemates with ₹2 lakh at stake. As Komban begins to doubt Shijin's intentions, Season 7 legends enter the house and judge everyone's performance.

videos.title: BBMal Day 69: Proof on Tape, Price to Pay
videos.overview: Lalettan issues Noby a yellow card and punishes a physical fight with direct nominations for three housemates. Video evidence exposes the fights, and safe housemates are announced.

videos.title: BBMal Day 70: Poetry, Guests and a Painful Exit
videos.overview: Special guests bring goodies, and legends connect via video call to resolve house feuds. Lalettan reviews teddy task issues and shares his new book before a painful eviction exit.

videos.title: BBMal Day 71: Race for Week 11 Leadership!
videos.overview: Luxury budget limits test the house, and mock nominations create tension. Food wastage fights erupt before the contestants battle for seats on the Leader Train.

videos.title: BBMal Day 72: Who Really Controls the Money Box?
videos.overview: Masked crew members drop a locked mystery box, kicking off the ₹4 lakh Bluff Master task. As Leader Azif sets the entry order, secret moves and sharp strategies begin in the house.

videos.title: BBMal Day 73: Who Landed the Prize Money?
videos.overview: Suspicion votes knock out Shijin and Mridula before Komban eliminates Rahul and Noby. The remaining three open their swapped briefcases, but who holds the real prize money?

videos.title: BBMal Day 74: A Rule Break Costs a Fortune
videos.overview: Komban's team wins a clue, but votes eliminate him and Azif. Later, Neha's secret leak forces Bigg Boss to cancel the task and budget, leaving Neha in tears and the house in anger.

videos.overview: Bigg Boss restarts the Bluff Master task, excluding Neha. The weekly tasks begin where clues are thrown around to guess who has the money box. Who will catch the right clue?

videos.overview: Mohanlal grills Neha over task leaks, airs video proof and orders jail time. The Bluff Master finale crowns its champion, and a tense eviction among Tashi, Wikky and Azif unfolds.

videos.title: BBMal Day 77: Laughter, Stories and Another Exit
videos.overview: Mohanlal shares laughs over hypnotism and cooking videos, reviews Azif's captaincy, and resolves Noby's complaints against Rahul. Stories air before another emotional exit.

videos.title: BBMal Day 78: The Season's Last Nomination
videos.overview: Neha stays in jail until further notice, and Azif's food delivery to her sparks a heated argument. Komban takes charge of the house, and the season's last nomination unfolds.

videos.title: BBMal Day 79: Family Week Joy and Jail Break
videos.overview: Family Week kicks off with the Freeze-Release task. Talking costs Mridula and Azif 50 luxury points. Meanwhile, Vipin, Mridula and Rahul's families visit.

videos.title: BBMal Day 80: Loved Ones Bring Joy to the House
videos.overview: A 200-point penalty sparks bitter clashes, while Azif protests kitchen duties. Later, Neha and Azif's families enter for emotional tasks, joyful dancing and heartfelt celebrations.

videos.title: BBMal Day 81: Captaincy Fights and Family Time
videos.overview: Komban clashes with Vipin, Rahul and Noby over chores and duties. Meanwhile, emotional family visits for Shijin and Komban bring special tasks into the house.

videos.title: BBMal Day 82: Family Visits, Pranks and BB Warning
videos.overview: Families of Aishwarya and Noby visit, Gautham gets a surprise, and the Nenjodu Cherth task ends. Later, a soapy prank by Noby and Gautham draws BB's warning.
